description: This file defines the BasketQueryService class, which provides a method to asynchronously count total items in a user's shopping basket by querying the database.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: Implements basket-related database queries, specifically counting total items in a basket for a given user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously computes the total number of items in a user's basket by summing their quantities.
